notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
Hello! We have made some major changes to our free demo. These updates include:

[list]
[*] A tutorial!
[*] Updated chat UI
[*] Two more optional quests
[*] Four new NPC:s to talk to
[*] Additional dialogue
[*] Other fun stuff
[/list]

Unfortunately, older saves are not compatible with the updated version. If you have old save files from previous demo versions it is best to delete them before playing the new one. Quite a lot has changed since the last update, so it might be worth the small inconvenience of having to start the demo over. 

Thank you for reading and we hope you enjoy the demo!

notes.title: Daughter of Crone is joining PixElatedFestival on July 29th
notes.content:
We love pixel art games, and we know you do too. So, let’s celebrate together 🎉 We’re super excited to share that Daughter of Crone joins PixElated Festival next week! This festival is featuring some of the best pixel art games on Steam. From retro-style classics to contemporary indie gems all in one place!
There will be: 

✨ discounts
✨ live streams
✨ art contest
✨ demos
✨ developer chats
✨ all centered around your favorite games.

Check out the official line-up and more information about the event here: http://pixelatedfest.com/

notes.title: Daughter of Crone Demo is Live!
notes.content:
After weeks of intensive development and bug-testing, we finally managed to get our demo to a playable state! The demo introduces you to a few of the residents in the village of Vilgesby and allows you to try out the core gameplay mechanics in Daughter of Crone, such as potion brewing, herb cultivation and turn-based combat. We hope you have fun exploring this little sample of our world that we have crafted for you!


- Team Jinxed Bird
